---
name: Feature proposal
about: Describe a problem and proposed scope for discussion.
title: ""
---

## Problem and use case

Who encounters this problem, and what are they trying to do?

## Current workaround

What do you do today, and where does it fall short?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-visible result, not just an implementation choice.

## Acceptance criteria and boundaries

What would show that this is solved? What is outside the proposed scope?

## References

Link related issues, roadmap items, or synthetic examples.

This is a proposal, not an accepted task or delivery commitment. Substantial implementation starts after scope and acceptance criteria are agreed. Until Discussions is live, issues also accept exploratory ideas.
